Results.ReviewText: Easy assembly instructions. Works well for a two burner barbecue. Plenty of heat and grill space for most 4 person meals and the fold down side tables certainly saves space while not in use. Only con so far is the annoying noise it creates while using one burner as the propane flows through the burner. Noise appears to be originating from the back of the barbecue.
Results.Title: Nice small family barbecue

Results.ReviewText: Great Grill perfect size and perfect function.  Operates smooth.
Results.Title: Great Grill

Results.ReviewText: Completely surprised.. This is only my second Weber, the first was a charcoal black charcoaler 50 years ago. First off I noticed that it maintains a temperature that you set it on. You want 450,500, whatever… it holds it. My old Kenmore, set at 400, cooked at 650. Don’t let the small size fool you. The second time I used it i purposely loaded it up with 6 tenderloins and 6 baked potatoes. All of it cooked just fine. I am impressed. Doesn’t take up the deck like the other 3 “Titanic’s” did that I have owned. Any thing I could say I’d like to see changed or not happy with? Have to be a nitpicker, could have come with a set of Weber grilling tools? All in all, I think I made a good choice and at a fair price. My kenmore lasted 14 years and moved on to a new home just down the street ( big yard). I’m thinking the little Weber will last me until I’m 86 or so. Let you know…
Results.Title: Compact size for a big cooker

Results.ReviewText: Compact yet fully capable of grilling for four to six adults.  The collapsible feature of the side shelves is perfect for storage.  Weber has really improved tge electronic lighting system!
Results.Title: Compact yet Mighty!

Results.ReviewText: After having another Weber grill for 20 years I find this new one is just not as good it only has three flavor bars which allow Flames to shoot up in between them and I found that food does not cook as well on this note Grill. So I'm not as happy
Results.Title: What happened to Weber grills

Results.ReviewText: This is our second unit.  It works very well, and we have had great results.  My main dislike is removing and installing the propane bottle.  Very awkward position, especially the new - and heavy -bottle.  There must be a better way

Results.ReviewText: The best I bought. What I love about it ,the ease to clean it. I had a messy inside from grill turkey burgers. I took it apart and cleaned in no time. I bought it  for ease of changing and buying parts .

Results.ReviewText: I replaced an older Genesis Silver with this smaller model as my new home has a smaller patio space. I had read that the two burner didn't heat quite as well as the three burner I was used to, but that definitely has not been my experience.  This unit is well built and works well and is easy to keep clean.  I do wish you had a griddle top.  I can use my old one but it basically takes up the whole grill space.  Other than that, I'm very happy with my purchase

Cooks really well and love the fold down side shelves to minimize space needed on the patio.  The two burners will get the unit up to 550 degrees, which is great for searing and for cleaning the cooking greats
Results.Title: Great little grill

Results.ReviewText: High quality grill with great features. Definitely worth the price. Like the old saying goes, “you get what you pay for”.
Results.Title: Gas grill Cadillac

Results.ReviewText: Seriously, I do not know why it took 57 years to purchase a Weber gas grill.  Sure, the price point might have had something to do with deterring me in the past but having to replace offf brand models every couple of years was certainly not cost effective in the long run.  Additionally, I could never figure out why I was never consistent with the quality of grilling results.  It seemed those who had a Weber grill had juicer,,more tender and aesthetically appealing foods. I gave it up to the fact that I was doing something wrong.  Well what I learned was Weber has perfected grilling performance and every little detail looks the burners, heat displacement, quality of the grates,  all have something to do with the results of good tasting and appealing food.  I couldn’t be happier with my Weber purchase!  I can be proud of the food I prepare on my Weber grill and will never sacrifice quality over a price.
Results.Title: Lesson learned

Results.ReviewText: We’ve had this bar b q  about 5-7 years and we are very satisfied with it.
Results.Title: Very good bar b q:

Results.Title: Weber

Results.ReviewText: Perfect grill for a family of 4 or less. Extremely well built and sturdy. Minimal flare ups due to the flame guards. Highly recommend.
Results.Title: A great grill

Results.ReviewText: Not a bad grill. I don’t think the propane scale is very accurate as I can move the tank by hand and the scale doesn't always come back to where it was before. Ours came with a different back side panel than what was on the one at Lowes and in the instruction manual. I think it looks weird being so wide open on the back but customer support told me it’s the newest model and Lowes must have been displaying an older one. I wasn't going to take it apart and return it at that point. Weber is trying to acquire me a back panel from last year’s model but it’s been a while so I don’t think I’m going to see it. I like the fold down side tables so you can use a smaller cover and it takes up less space on the patio. But keep in mind, if you fold the tables down you have no where to hang grill tools. Maybe the front handle-TBD. Another thing I don’t like is that the entire upper section / firebox is only connected to the lower section with 2 small bolts so if you happen to try and lift the grill over a crack in the patio concrete, the top part flexes where you think it might break off. Kind of a weird design I think. I have a Spirit 300 from 10 years ago and it doesn't connect like that, I can move that thing all around and doesn't make me nervous. Oh well, costs cuts or engineering to keep the price in line.
Results.Title: Good size for 2 people

Results.ReviewText: I had a three burner Weber Genesis 1000 gas grill for 26 years. Replaced a few parts here and there, but it worked like a champ up until I had to retire it. Bought a new Weber E-210 two burner grill earlier this summer. So far, so good. If the E-210 grill gives me half the life of my 1000 grill I'll be very pleased.
Results.Title: Hoping for long service life

Results.ReviewText: Love my new grill ❣️ I’ve had a Weber grill before and I’ll never use another, I moved and the buyer of the house asked me to leave the grill, I haven’t had one for 5 years and I’m so excited to have another 🤗

Results.ReviewText: Great grill and plenty big for any home. I do think they should close the back of the grill fully. Seems odd to have it open where it is exposed to the elements and any creature seeking refuge from them.

Results.ReviewText: Good grill. no better than others. Sadly, the grill came with missing items - twice! Had to call to have them sent, the delivery was anything but smooth. We had to wait one week for the first item to be delivered and two more weeks for the second. AND they were in stock!
Results.Title: Missing in Action

Results.ReviewText: We have a Weber Spirit E-210.  This is our second Spirit. Our first Spirit was close to 23 years old when we cleaned it up and put the grill at the end of our driveway. We could have gotten a couple more years out of this grill. Someone nabbed that grill immediately. The grill is used all year long. You can get an entire meal on this smaller grill. This grill is superior to other brands for the quality Weber puts into all their products. We keep the grill outside all year but covered when not in use. Years earlier we had one of the larger Weber grills but we also had three children at home. Loved that grill also. We are now in our late 60s and eat smaller portions. If Weber had a smaller grill, we would invest in it.  If you’re looking for a sturdy, long lasting grill, this is a good investment. I can’t say enough about those cast iron grates.
Results.Title: Weber is a good investment

Results.ReviewText: Small and perfect for our space. Love that it requires less gas than a 3 burner.
Results.Title: Great for small spaces

Results.ReviewText: Love the fold down trays on the sides along with the quick efficient automatic startup of the grill. The gas gage is another feature that is impressive along with the front door and locking wheels. An excellent product that I'm glad I purchased.
Results.Title: Overall review

46110001.Description:
Taste the difference a Spirit will make in your life. With features such as porcelain enameled, cast-iron cooking grates that retain even heat, you’re guaranteed the best tasting food. It’s built to last with a cookbox that helps prevent rusting and peeling, and conveniently equipped with six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools. If that wasn’t enough, the low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system takes the hassle out of cooking. Designed to fit on a small patio or balcony, the Spirit E-210 gas grill brings grilling to any home.


• Durable, easy-to-clean porcelain-enamel cast iron grates.

• Porcelain-enameled finish helps prevent rusting and pealing.

• Six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools.

• Low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system.

• 360 square inches of main grilling space.
